contribution: A Nigerian nationalist, politician, surveyor, engineer, architect, journalist, and musician.

checks.lead: Olayinka Herbert Samuel Heelas Badmus Macaulay   (14 November 1864 – 7 May 1946) was a Nigerian nationalist, politician, surveyor, engineer, architect, journalist, and musician. Macaulay is considered by many as the founder of Nigerian nationalism.
